source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official repository identity, reverse-geocoding purpose and public instance.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Nominatim searches OpenStreetMap data by name and address and generates synthetic addresses of OSM points by reverse geocoding. The public instance is https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Reverse endpoint, closest-object semantics, WGS84 inputs, building zoom and address layer.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Reverse geocoding does not exactly compute the address for the requested coordinate. It returns the closest suitable OSM object, which may belong to a different street. The endpoint is /reverse with WGS84 lat and lon; zoom 18 corresponds to building detail and layer=address restricts results to address objects.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: JSONv2 response fields and identifier persistence limitations.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: JSON/JSONv2 reverse output can include licence, osm_type, osm_id, lat, lon, display_name, category/type, boundingbox and address details. place_id is not persistent; osm_type plus osm_id is an OSM object reference but can change when objects are deleted, split or recreated.
